gate_type: CORRECTION gate — SH-WTP T106->T108 Explicit Lagged Federation identity locking (G14B-C01)
objective: Lock the SH-WTP federation participant adapters' federation identity to the wrapped runtimes' immutable RunContextV2. Both ShwtpT106Participant and ShwtpT108Participant must fail closed at construction when runtime.run_context.workspace_id != adapter workspace_id, when runtime.run_context.run_id != adapter run_id, or when the runtime scope path is not the exact T106/T108 path. Enforce the invariant runtime.run_context.workspace_id == adapter workspace_id == 'shwtp' and runtime.run_context.run_id == adapter run_id. The adapter never mutates the RunContext, never rewrites runtime identity, and never derives a new run id after construction. The T106 emitted BoundaryTransfer.run_id must equal the T106 runtime RunContext run_id and the T106 step provenance run_id. T108 provenance must keep the same federation run identity. Preserve all G14B semantics (explicit_lagged, one-window lag, F01 only, T106+T108 only, no T110, no F02-F07, no G4 change, no T106/T108 equation change, no F01 projection change, no policy expansion, no G15).
explicit_non_objectives: No T106/T108 domain equation or provenance-fidelity change
forbidden_actions: Change T106/T108 equations, canonical ids, or provenance
Change RunContextV2 contract or G2 identity semantics
Silently derive a new run id after construction
stop_conditions: Fixing identity locking requires changing G2/G4 identity semantics or the frozen RunContext contract
A new global engine/scheduler architecture is required
